prompt:
Our fintech AI team has been running daily training sessions using the AgentDojo system, but no one has actually executed a proper session that produces the required output files yet. I need you to run a complete training session for our team right now.

The configuration lives in `config/agentdojo.config.yaml` and the drill definitions are in `config/drills/`. After the run, I need two things:
1. A session log file called `run_record.json` saved under `outputs/runs/`.
2. A daily digest report saved under `outputs/reports/` (you pick a sensible filename).

We have a strict spending limit this month, so please make sure the session does not exceed whatever caps are configured. Also, focus the session on the areas where our agents are weakest — there's no point drilling things they're already good at.
